rule: Account_No must not be null

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full_Name is a mandatory identifier for customer records

rule: Full_Name must follow Title Case convention (first letter of each word capitalized) except for known lowercase particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows case inconsistencies including lowercase names ('junrong', 'irfan') and mixed case ('Hui Min tan', 'Lee yixuan') that deviate from the dominant title-like convention

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must match Name from Cust_Bio_dirty when compared case-insensitively
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key between tables, and both tables store the customer's name which must be consistent across the dataset

check_params.semantic_check: Full_Name must exactly match Name from Cust_Bio_dirty when both are converted to the same case (case-insensitive comparison)

rule: Name particles (Bin/Binte/s/o/d/o) must be consistent with Gender from Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use specific particles to indicate gender: Bin or s/o indicates Male, while Binte or d/o indicates Female. These must align with the Gender field in Cust_Bio_dirty.

check_params.semantic_check: If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o' (case-insensitive), Gender must be 'Male'; if Full_Name contains 'Binte' or 'd/o' (case-insensitive), Gender must be 'Female'

rule: ID must not be null

rule: ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter prefix (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase checksum letter

rule: ID must exactly match ID_No from Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N

check_params.semantic_check: ID must exactly match ID_No from the corresponding record in Cust_Bio_dirty
